Print Director version.

## Synopsis

```text
version
```

Words without brackets are required, `[ ]` marks optional parts, `a | b` alternatives, `...` a repeatable argument and `[,...]` a comma separated list.

## Description

Prints the Director's name, version and build date.

## Examples

Name, version and build date of the running Director:

```text
version
```
